summary: Datasheet-verified cross-reference alternatives for TLV7011DBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5, comparator-single): evaluated 21 same-category OPNs and shortlisted the top 8 ranked replacements (0 Level 1 Candidate Drop-In, 1 Level 2 Tuning Required, and 7 Level 3 Layout Change). Verify pinout, thermal margin, lifecycle status, and official manufacturer datasheets before production.

selection_checklist: Verify device class (comparator) and output stage (push-pull) — never substitute an uncompensated comparator for a compensated op-amp, or vice versa, without circuit redesign; only open-collector/open-drain outputs require an external pull-up.
Confirm supply rail span (1.6–5.5 V rec, 6 V abs max) and exact SOT-23-5 pinout (1=OUT, 2=VEE, 3=IN_POS, 4=IN_NEG, 5=VCC).
Verify input common-mode headroom (RR-In), output swing (RR-Out), and Vos (8 mV max) against signal chain budget.
Check closed-loop bandwidth (GBWP / Acl), full-power slew rate (SR / 2π·Vpeak), and capacitive-load phase margin on the bench.
